name: Transformer main-tank oil-level alarm
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Reports the documented low or abnormal oil-level condition in the main tank system.
description: Reports the documented low or abnormal oil-level condition in the main tank system. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Main oil-level contact” at the input and “Main-tank level alarm” at the output. Oil level varies with operating conditions.
